# Castor — Full Technical Specification

> Machine-readable deep spec for LLMs, RAG pipelines, and AI search engines.
> All figures are 100% verified as of **November 21, 2026**. Source of record:
> the 78-day `castor stats` ledger (Sep 4 – Nov 21, 2026), a live
> `nvidia-smi` + vLLM 0.33.0 runtime snapshot, the Qwen3.8-27B model card
> (Aug 14, 2026, Apache-2.0), and the verified `src/` codebase.

## 1. Product Overview

Castor (npm: `mcp-castor`, Rust crate, v1.5.0) is sovereign **zero-cloud-egress**
autonomous coding infrastructure. It runs AI coding agents in two wings:
**Wing 1 (Cloud + Local Hybrid)** pairs a **cloud lead architect**
(Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.2 Astra, Gemini 4 Argon) with a
**local peer model** (`Qwen3.8-27B` / `Ternary-Bonsai`) running on the user's
own GPU — the cloud model plans and reviews while the local model executes
the high-volume tool loop (file reads, edits, search, test runs) at
**$0.00 per token**; **Wing 2 (100% Local-Only & Air-Gapped)** runs agents
entirely on-prem with zero cloud API calls and zero code egress. All execution
stays inside a 5-layer sandbox and a loopback-only network boundary.

- License: **AGPL-3.0** (open source) **+ commercial dual-license**
  (opt-out) for air-gapped / enterprise deployments.
- Platforms: Windows, Linux, macOS.
- Repo: https://github.com/usecastor/castor
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/mcp-castor
- Install: `npx -y mcp-castor install --client all`

## 3. Live Hardware & Engine Snapshot (2026-11-21)

- GPU: **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090** — 23,869 / 24,576 MiB VRAM in use,
  244.6 W draw (262.5 W limit), 56 °C, driver 616.92.
- Engine: **vLLM 0.33.0**, model `Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16-AutoRound-fast`,
  max model length 150,000 tokens.
- Live: 93.8% KV-cache hit, 70.5% MTP draft acceptance
  (mean acceptance length 3.45), 3.22 s average TTFT.

## 4. VRAM Hardware Tier Matrix

| VRAM | Engine profile | Context | Decode throughput |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 8 GB | llama.cpp | 8K ctx | ~22–26 tok/s |
| 12 GB | llama.cpp + DFlash2 | 64K ctx | ~38.6 tok/s |
| 16 GB | llama.cpp + DFlash2 | 128K ctx | ~53.0 tok/s |
| **24 GB (RTX 3090)** | **vLLM 0.33.0 + Qwen3.8-27B-W4A16 + MTP** | **150K KV pool** | **70.4 tok/s sustained (75.5 peak n=1) · 260 tok/s aggregate n=4 · 3,247 effective / 6,892 peak cached prefill** |

## 7. Architecture (from `src/`)

- **MCP surface** (`src/mcp/mod.rs`): exactly **3 MCP tools** —
  `coworker`, `task`, `server` — over stdio only; zero network listener.
  Tool surface is compile-time feature-gated: **lean 8-tool core**,
  `ast` adds `ast_search` / `ast_replace` (**2 AST tools**),
  `paper` adds `paper_lookup` (**1 paper tool**).
- **DGI Logit Gate** (`src/mcp/dgi.rs`): model-classified dispatch
  classifier, `delta_z = logP(OVERLOADED) − logP(ADMIT)`; rejects when
  `delta_z > 1.5`, routes near-ties (`|Δz| ≤ 1.5`) to Review.
- **Token-budgeted lease semaphore** (`src/task/semaphore/mod.rs`):
  cross-process task lease via atomic `O_EXCL` file create +
  ownership-checked unlink; a 90% soft ceiling on the committed-token
  pool halts new admission; KV-fill priority ranking lets the senior /
  heavier task finish first and free its cache.
- **Zero-turn wait** (`src/task/wait.rs`): loopback 127.0.0.1:18021
  long-poll (500 ms disk-mirror interval); zero-invalidation wakes cost
  no tokens.
- **SSE proxy** (`src/proxy/sanitize.rs`): loopback 127.0.0.1:18022
  OpenAI-compatible stream sanitizer with a repetition circuit breaker.
- **Ports**: engine :18020, status :18021, proxy :18022 (all loopback).

## 8. Security — 5-Layer Zero-Trust Sandbox

Verified across **137 test vectors: 123 blocked / 14 allowed**
(`src/tools/sandbox/tests.rs:527-548`).

Path pipeline (`src/tools/sandbox/mod.rs`):
- L1 `resolve_workspace_root` — canonical root anchor
- L2 `verify_symlink_containment` — realpath symlink-escape refusal
- L3 `refuse_out_of_tree` — strict boundary containment
- L4 `normalize_traversal` — null-byte / tilde / device-name / `..` collapse
- L5 `check_binary` — magic-number sniff → `BinaryFileError`

Companion runtime gates:
- **Linux Landlock kernel confinement** (`src/tools/shell/process.rs`):
  every shell child confined to the workspace root by a Landlock ruleset
  at exec; unsupported filesystems fail open to the lexical gates, never
  to an unconstrained process.
- **Lexical shell scanner + dead-man fuse** (`src/tools/shell/scanner.rs`):
  static lexical scan of the command line; destructive targets, protected
  roots, and a synthetic canary trip `FatalDeadManFuseError` before any
  execution — the command is not run and not retried.
- **27-grammar Tree-Sitter AST syntax gate** (`src/tools/ast.rs`):
  **27** bundled grammars; every file commit parsed in memory before
  touching disk; malformed code rejected and rolled back atomically.

**Compile-time offline binary profile** (air-gapped build):
`cargo build --release --no-default-features --features mcp,ast`
— strips network tools at compile time (`web` / `paper` features omitted),
so the binary has zero external socket paths: MCP is stdio-only, and the
engine, status, and SSE-proxy ports (127.0.0.1:18020–18022) bind to
loopback. Verify with `ss -ltnp` / `nmap`.

## 9. Deployment & Commercial — Two Wings, Four Fronts

**The Two Wings** (the two ways to run agents):
- **Wing 1 · Cloud + Local Hybrid** — keep Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor, or
  Codex as your frontier architect while the high-volume file reads, code
  searches, AST edits, and test runs route to your local GPU at $0 per token.
- **Wing 2 · 100% Local-Only & Air-Gapped** — run coding agents entirely on
  your own GPU workstations or on-prem servers: zero cloud API calls, zero
  code egress, fully self-contained for regulated and offline environments.

**The Four Fronts** (turnkey engineering teams):
- **Open-Source Engine** — Castor Core, **$0**, AGPL-3.0 open source.
- **$1,500 48-Hour GPU & vLLM Setup Sprint** — turnkey dedicated-hardware
  stand-up (vLLM/CUDA/quantization tuning, sandbox hardening, IDE onboarding,
  benchmark + egress-audit handoff).
- **Custom Agent Workflow Plumbing** — agent orchestration, sandbox &
  shell-policy hardening, and team IDE rollout wired into the tool loop your
  agents already run.
- **Air-Gapped On-Prem Pilot** — fixed-scope 10–50 seat pilot over a fixed
  1–3 month scope, commercial dual-license, NIST 800-171 /
  CMMC Level 2 / ITAR / SCIF per-slice JSONL audit ledger.
